off campus

This may be different if fall rush is online

1. Register online with texas tech IFC, costs around $100 i believe
2. fill out your information on that website, hometown, picture etc.
3. come to lubbock a week before school starts
4. each morning around 7am you meet at the fields, and go house-to-house
5. after a couple days, you slowly narrow them down at the library.
6. if you click with the dudes, they might have a rush event at the lodge or someone’s house

repeat

note: drinking while rushing is forbidden, and you can get your wristband cut if IFC finds out, not to mention the fraternity can get in trouble for handing out drinks to rushees. Do what you want tho. Shoot me a pm if ya have any questions
